[[Bogroot Rod]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[wand]] dropped by the [[Bogroot Chest]], after finishing [[Giriff's War]] or [[Tekks's War]] in [[Sparkfly Swamp]].

==Stats==
:[[Chaos damage|Chaos Dmg]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Inspiration Magic]])
:[[HSR|Halves skill recharge]] of Inspiration Magic [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:[[HCT|Halves casting time]] of Inspiration Magic spells (Chance: 20%)

==Replica==

Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*One of the following Inspiration Magic wands:
**[[Destroyer Scepter]] from crafter [[Balthor Coalforge]]
**[[Imperial Scepter]] from collector [[Shen Xi]]
**[[Tormented Scepter]] from collector [[Deacon of Whispers]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Aptitude not Attitude]]" inscription
OR
*One of the following Inspiration Magic wands:
**[[Crystal Wand]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
**[[Asuran Scepter]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Rod]] from collector [[Zaishen Mesmeric Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Scepter]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Fan of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
**[[Norn Scepter]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Scepter]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Charr Scepter]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Mursaat Scepter]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)

==Unique counterparts==
*The Inspiration Magic version of [[Droknar's Scepter]] has stats identical to this item.
*[[Garbok's Cane]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it requires [[Domination Magic]].
